parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The alias of the OTA module. The alias can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Desc
parameters.description: The description of the OTA module. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the OTA module. The name must be unique within the product and cannot be modified. The name can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It must be 1 to 64 characters in length.
> Letters are case-insensitive. For example, "scanner" and "Scanner" are considered the same module name and cannot be used repeatedly.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the OTA module belongs.
